## About
AK Dental of Austin is a family and general dental office led by Dr. Devisree Nekkanti. From our Arboretum office on Research Blvd, above Lamps Plus and near The Cheesecake Factory, we see neighbors from Great Hills, Balcones Woods, Wooten, Bull Creek, McNeil, and Jollyville.
Dr. Nekkanti earned her DMD from Rutgers School of Dental Medicine and completed a fellowship in Orofacial Pain and TMJ Disorders. She is a member of the American Dental Association and the Texas Dental Association, and she speaks English, Spanish, and Telugu.
Her goal is simple: a place where people feel listened to, cared for, and respected. She takes time to understand what each patient needs, explains the options, and builds a treatment plan around comfort and long-lasting results.

## Services
- Dental cleanings: Professional cleanings add a layer of care to your routine at home and help keep your natural teeth healthy.
- Dental fillings: Fillings protect a tooth after decay is removed and can also repair cracked or broken teeth.
- Dental crowns: A crown covers the top of the tooth, giving it strength so you can smile and chew with confidence.
- Dental bridges: Bridges replace missing teeth and help restore how your smile works and looks.
- Dental implants: Implants are a popular way to replace missing teeth.
- Partial and full dentures: Dentures custom fit to your mouth so they look and feel natural.
- Dental bonding: Bonding helps give you a more even, uniform smile.
- Invisalign: Dr. Nekkanti is a certified Invisalign provider.
- Emergency dentistry: Care for urgent dental problems.

## FAQ
Q: Do you see kids and the whole family?
A: Yes. Dr. Nekkanti provides general dental care for patients of all ages, so the whole family can come to one office.

Q: Where is the office?
A: We are at the Arboretum on Research Blvd, suite 260, above Lamps Plus and near The Cheesecake Factory.

Q: What languages does Dr. Nekkanti speak?
A: She speaks English, Spanish, and Telugu.
